description: This file defines a Unity MonoBehaviour class that handles Vuforia initialization errors by displaying error messages and managing error states within a Unity application.

classes.name: DefaultInitializationErrorHandler
classes.description: A Unity MonoBehaviour class that handles Vuforia initialization errors by displaying error messages and providing user interface controls.

methods.name: OnVuforiaInitializationError
methods.description: Handles Vuforia initialization errors by setting error messages and updating error state.

methods.name: Awake
methods.description: Registers the error callback with VuforiaRuntime on object initialization.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Sets up GUI styles when the script starts.

methods.name: OnGUI
methods.description: Displays a full-screen error window if an error has occurred.

methods.name: OnDestroy
methods.description: Unregisters the error callback when the object is destroyed.

methods.name: DrawWindowContent
methods.description: Draws the error message window with a close button.

methods.name: SetErrorCode
methods.description: Sets the error message based on the specific Vuforia initialization error code.

methods.name: SetErrorOccurred
methods.description: Updates the internal error state flag.

methods.name: getKeyInfo
methods.description: Provides information about the current Vuforia license key.

methods.name: SetupGUIStyles
methods.description: Initializes GUI styles and textures for error display.

methods.name: CreateSinglePixelTexture
methods.description: Creates a 1x1 pixel texture of a specified color for GUI styling.
